lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਪਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਿਭਾਸ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag parabhaatee bibhaas mahalaa 1 chaupade ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Parbhaatee Bibhaas, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਤਰਣਾ ਨਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਜ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai terai taranaa naai pat pooj ||
lines.translation: Your Name carries us across; Your Name brings respect and worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ਮਤਿ ਮਕਸੂਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naau teraa gahanaa mat makasood ||
lines.translation: Your Name embellishes us; it is the object of the awakened mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai terai naau ma(n)ne sabh koi ||
lines.translation: Your Name brings honor to everyone's name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai pat kabahu na hoi ||1||
lines.translation: Without Your Name, no one is ever respected. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲੀ ਪਾਜੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar siaanap sagalee paaj ||
lines.translation: All other clever tricks are just for show.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਤੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਾਜੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jai bakhase tai pooraa kaaj ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whoever the Lord blesses with forgiveness - his affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਨਾਉ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naau teraa taan naau deebaan ||
lines.translation: Your Name is my strength; Your Name is my support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਲਸਕਰੁ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naau teraa lasakar naau sulataan ||
lines.translation: Your Name is my army; Your Name is my king.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai terai maan mahat paravaan ||
lines.translation: Your Name brings honor, glory and approval.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: teree nadaree karam pavai neesaan ||2||
lines.translation: By Your Grace, one is blessed with the banner and the insignia of Your Mercy. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਨਾਇ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai terai sahaj naai saalaah ||
lines.translation: Your Name brings intuitive peace and poise; Your Name brings praise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naau teraa a(n)mrit bikh uth jaai ||
lines.translation: Your Name is the Ambrosial Nectar which cleans out the poison.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਵਸਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai terai sabh sukh vasahi man aai ||
lines.translation: Through Your Name, all peace and comfort comes to abide in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai baadhee jam pur jaai ||3||
lines.translation: Without the Name, they are bound and gagged, and dragged off to the City of Death. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰੀ ਬੇਰੀ ਘਰ ਦਰ ਦੇਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: naaree beree ghar dar des ||
lines.translation: Man is involved with his wife, hearth and home, land and country,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਵੇਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: man keeaa khuseeaa keechahi ves ||
lines.translation: the pleasures of the mind and fine clothes;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਸਦੇ ਤਾਂ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) sade taa(n) dhil na paai ||
lines.translation: but when the call comes, he cannot delay.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kooR kooRo hoi jaai ||4||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, in the end, the false turn out to be false. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਤਿਥੈ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa naam ratan karam chaanan surat tithai loi ||
lines.translation: Your Name is the Jewel, and Your Grace is the Light. In awareness, there is Your Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਅੰਧੀ ਵਾਪਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਲੀਜੈ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dher a(n)dhee vaaparai sagal leejai khoi ||1||
lines.translation: Darkness fills the dark, and then everything is lost. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu sa(n)saar sagal bikaar ||
lines.translation: This whole world is corrupt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa naam daaroo avar naasat karanahaar apaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Your Name is the only cure; nothing else works, O Infinite Creator Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਾਲ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਭਾਰ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: paataal pureeaa ek bhaar hovahi laakh karoR ||
lines.translation: One side of the scale holds tens of thousands, millions of nether regions and realms.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਤਾ ਪਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਸਿਰੈ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਹੋਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tere laal keemat taa pavai jaa(n) sirai hovahi hor ||2||
lines.translation: O my Beloved, Your Worth could only be estimated if something else could be placed on the other side of the scale. ||2||
